name: Classic Sound Effects Pack
author: HyruleChosenOne
tagline: Authentic Pokémon Emerald menu UI, Poké Ball, battle hit, and attack/move SFX + classic Gen 3 fanfares.
description: Overhauls PokéBonk with 94 authentic Gen 3 sound effects: genuine Pokémon Emerald menu & UI sounds (SE_SELECT confirm, cursor scroll, denied buzzer, Poké Mart shop, save, PokéNav, EXP bar pip, Shiny sparkle, Poké Ball throw/open/shake/click), Emerald battle effectiveness hits & Faint KO, 47 authentic Emerald move & attack sounds wired directly into PokéBonk's move dispatcher (Ember, Flamethrower, Surf, Hydro Pump, Thunderbolt, Razor Leaf, Solar Beam, Ice Beam, Blizzard, Psybeam, Shadow Ball, Bite, Brick Break, Earthquake, Hyper Beam, Explosion, and more), plus 16 Gen 3 milestone fanfares.
highlights: Authentic Pokémon Emerald menu & UI SFX (SE_SELECT confirm, cursor scroll, denied buzzer, item use, shop, save, PokéNav, Shiny sparkle, Poké Ball capture)
47 authentic Pokémon Emerald move & elemental attack SFX hooked directly into PokéBonk's per-move audio engine across all 144+ moves & all 18 types
Genuine Emerald effectiveness hits (Normal / Super Effective / Not Very Effective), Faint KO, ledge hop, and flee dash
16 classic Gen 3 milestone fanfares (Level Up!, Healed, Caught!, Evolved!, Victory, Defeat, Jackpot, Boss Intro) — 100% Client-side & Co-op safe

changes: Verified all 94 authentic Pokémon Emerald UI, Poké Ball, battle hit, move, and fanfare SFX on PokéBonk v0.10.36.
Wired 47 authentic Pokémon Emerald attack & elemental move SFX into PokéBonk's per-move audio dispatcher across all 18 types.

preservedVersions.note: Preserved release for PokéBonk Unbound v1.0.5 (Offline PokéBonk v0.10.31).
